RHYME DIAL

How to use

Use the Rhyme Dial to help you find more words. Type a word, then move through the alphabet with the arrows or the center shield to try different letters.

Click a letter to select the position you want to change. Click that selected letter again to lock it. Click a locked letter to unlock and select it. Locked positions stay fixed. The underline marks the selected letter that the arrows and sword change.

Break a word into smaller parts and work on one part at a time. Keep a beginning, ending, or sound you like, then change the letters around it. This can help you spot words, rhymes, and combinations you might not have thought of.

You can also tap any letter on the outer ring. Some combinations won’t be words—keep moving through the letters and see what you find.
